title: Launchpad primer: newcomer checklist badges & empty-state spotlight
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, persistent 'launchpad primer' UI that surfaces a newcomer checklist as small status badges in the Console header and contextual empty-state spotlights within common routes (Models, Deployments, Usage). The goal is to provide low-friction guidance for first-time users while keeping the control plane uncluttered for returning users.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist badge component (SVG + tokenized CSS) implemented in Figma with 3 size variants: compact, medium, expanded
Empty-state spotlight art and copy for 3 routes (Models, Deployments, Usage) delivered as SVG + PNG @1x and @2x
Accessible interactions: keyboard focus styles, ARIA labels, and screen-reader copy provided for badges and tooltips
Microcopy approved by PM and Content (final strings documented in Confluence doc)
Prototype in Figma shows badge appearing when user has 0 completed steps, transitions to 'complete' state when the Analytics flag is set
Engineering sign-off on spacing tokens and export assets; a sample React component API sketch included
Design handoff package uploaded to Drive with naming convention: console/launchpad-primer/{asset-type}/{route}/{variant}.
design_assets: Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED - handoff folder (SVG, PNG, tokens.json, copy.md)

decisions: Use persistent badge (header) instead of modal-first onboarding to avoid interrupting power users
Prefer progressive disclosure: badge opens a slide-over checklist rather than full-screen takeover
Illustrations will be monochrome with subtle accent color to minimize export sizes and blend with dark mode
Badges will have 3 visual states: hidden, active (incomplete), and complete — engineered by a single CSS token set
No telemetry required for assets themselves; rely on existing analytics flags (ENG-21021) to detect completion
